summaries.en: English-level-up-tips is a comprehensive guide for Chinese speakers aiming to master English efficiently. It distills proven language acquisition principles into a structured roadmap, emphasizing input-based learning (listening and reading) over rote memorization. The guide covers phonetics, vocabulary, grammar, and cultural immersion, with practical tips like using spaced repetition and native materials. You can follow the step-by-step plan to build a personalized study routine, or adapt its strategies for teaching others.

summaries.en: iii is an open-source framework for building and managing real-time, composable services. It unifies APIs, agents, and backend logic into a single, observable system. Technically, it leverages Rust for performance and provides primitives for JavaScript, TypeScript, and Python. summary_short.zh: Stop-slop 是一款专用于去除AI生成文本中常见痕迹的技能文件，旨在使机器写作更自然、更接近人类。其核心并非重新生成内容，而是通过一系列有针对性的编辑规则，消除典型AI腔调，如过度使用的短语、重复句式和不自然过渡词。技术上，它提供系统化的后处理方法，专注于风格优化而非内容创造。可作为独立工具使用，也可集成到AI写作流程中，用于润色草稿、提升可读性，使新闻稿、报告或创意写作摆脱千篇一律的机器感。

summaries.en: Stop-slop is a skill file designed to remove common AI tells from prose, making generated text sound more natural and human-like. It works by applying targeted edits to eliminate overused phrases, repetitive structures, and unnatural transitions typical of AI writing. Technically, it provides a systematic approach to post-process AI output, focusing on stylistic refinement rather than content generation. You can use it as a standalone tool or integrate it into your AI writing pipeline to polish drafts, improve readability, and reduce the 'AI voice' in newsletters, reports, or creative writing.

summary_short.zh: Claude Code Harness 是一个自主开发框架，它将 Claude Code 封装成结构化的“计划→工作→审查”循环，解决了 AI 辅助编码中输出质量不稳定的问题。其核心设计理念是强制 AI 在编码前先制定计划、编码后进行审查，模仿人类最佳实践，从而提升代码的可靠性和可维护性。你可以通过将其集成到现有的 Claude Code 环境中，来自动化复杂的编码任务，并确保每次输出都经过严格的质量控制。

summaries.en: Claude Code Harness is an autonomous development framework that wraps Claude Code into a structured Plan→Work→Review cycle, solving the problem of inconsistent output quality in AI-assisted coding. Its key insight is enforcing a disciplined workflow where the AI plans before coding and reviews after, mimicking human best practices. You can use it to automate complex coding tasks, ensuring higher reliability and maintainability by simply integrating it into your existing Claude Code setup.
